（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

S. I. O.
G. O. REC.
No. 629 AM
Date 9/10/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

9th October 1916

Sir,
No leave will be granted to the troops on the 10th inst.
At 10 a.m. on the 10th inst all Chinese officials
will meet in the Yea Sz Yuen 也是園 Garden in the city
and hold a memorial service in honour of all deceased rebels.

The City Fire Brigade are holding their annual
competition to-day on a piece of waste ground near the
Shanghai Hangchow Railway Station.

At noon on the 8th inst Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚 , one
of the rebel leaders, entertained 30 members of the Anwhui
Provincial Assembly, to tiffin in the Yih Ping Shan
Restaurant 一品香 .

The destitute rebels are still visiting at intervals
the office for Repatriation and making trouble. They have
been promised a small advance on the 10th instant.

There is no change in the situation in the painters
dispute.

It is reported that Mr. Sung Ming Tsang 沈銘昌, Civil
Governor of Shansi, arrived at Shanghai at 9.20 p.m. on
October 8th from Nanking. He was accompanied by three
soldiers who had with them 2 Mauser Rifles, 1 Sword and 1
Revolver. They went in a motor car to No. 18 Chung Kwe
Road, Frenchtown. They had the necessary passport signed
by the Senior Consul. Nothing further unusual was reported
during the day.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：
welcomed
today
9-10-16.
）

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探科。）

S. I. O.
G. O. REC.
第 629 AM 号
日期 1916年10月9日

致上海工部局。

1916年10月9日

先生：

本月10日，军队不予准假。
本月10日上午10时，所有中国官员将在城内的也是園（Yea Sz Yuen）花园集会，举行纪念仪式，以悼念所有已故的革命党人。

市消防队今日在上海杭州火车站附近的一块空地上举行年度竞赛。

本月8日中午，革命党领导人之一柏文蔚（Pah Vung Wei）在“一品香”餐馆（Yih Ping Shan Restaurant）设午宴招待30名安徽省议会议员。

贫困的革命党人仍不时前往遣返办公室滋事。已许诺于本月10日向他们发放少量预付款。

油漆工纠纷的局势没有变化。

据报，山西省民政长沈銘昌（Sung Ming Tsang）于10月8日晚9时20分从南京抵达上海。随行有三名士兵，携带毛瑟步枪2支、军刀1把和左轮手枪1支。他们乘汽车前往法租界钟桂路（Chung Kwe Road）18号。他们持有总领事签署的必要护照。当日未报告其他异常情况。

您顺从的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

（左侧手写批注：
已阅
今日
1916年10月9日。
）
